Serving Sizes: 1 slice bread, 1/2 cup dry cereal, 1/2 cup cooked rice, pasta, or cereal
Examples and Notes: Whole-wheat bread, muffin, pita bread, bagel, cereals, oatmeal
Contribution to the DASH Diet Pattern: Major sources of calories and fiber

Serving Sizes: 1 cup raw, leafy vegetables, 1/2 cup cooked vegetables, 6 oz vegetable juice
Examples and Notes: Tomatoes, potatoes, carrots, peas, squash, broccoli, turnip greens, kale, spinach, artichokes, green beans, sweet potatoes
Contribution to the DASH Diet Pattern: Rich sources of potassium, magnesium, and fiber

Serving Sizes: 1 medium fruit, 1/2 cup dried fruit, 6 oz fruit juice, 1/2 cup fresh, frozen, or canned fruit
Examples and Notes: Apricots, bananas, dates, oranges, orange juice, grapefruit, grapefruit juice, mangoes, melons, peaches, pineapples, prunes, raisins, strawberries, tangerines
Contribution to the DASH Diet Pattern: Important sources of potassium, magnesium, and fiber

Serving Sizes: 8 oz milk, 1 cup yogurt, 1.5 oz cheese
Examples and Notes: Skim or low-fat (2%) milk, skim or low-fat buttermilk, nonfat or low-fat yogurt, nonfat or low-fat cheeses
Contribution to the DASH Diet Pattern: Major sources of calcium and protein

Serving Sizes: 3 oz cooked meats, poultry, or fish
Examples and Notes: Select only lean meats; trim away visible fats; broil, roast, or boil instead of frying; remove skin from poultry
Contribution to the DASH Diet Pattern: Rich sources of protein and magnesium

Serving Sizes: 1.5 oz or 1/2 cup nuts, 1/2 oz or 2 tbsp seeds, 1/2 cup cooked legumes
Examples and Notes: Almonds, mixed nuts, peanuts, walnuts, sunflower seeds, kidney beans, lentils, split peas
Contribution to the DASH Diet Pattern: Rich sources of calories, magnesium, potassium, protein, and fiber
